title: Electrical engineering
blurb: How electrical plant behaves, ashore and afloat: circuits and electronics, machines and generators, supply systems and installation design. Each course is built in full before you open it.

folders.title: Electrical principles
folders.blurb: The behaviour of AC circuits and the machines built on it, in principles that hold on any installation.

courses.title: AC circuits
courses.blurb: From the turning coil to three-phase power: rms, reactance, impedance, power factor and its correction, star and delta.

courses.title: Electronics and power electronics
courses.blurb: Diodes, transistors and the converters built from them: rectifiers, inverters and what is inside a drive or a UPS.

courses.title: Transformers and magnetism
courses.blurb: Electromagnetism from first principles, then the transformer: turns ratio, losses, regulation, vector groups and stepping 440 V down to 115 V.

folders.title: Power and machines at sea
folders.blurb: Machines and the cables between them: motors, generators and paralleling, and testing HV subsea cables.

courses.title: Motors
courses.blurb: What you need to know on each motor: how it works, how it behaves, where it is used, how it fails, and the starter and drive that control it.

courses.title: Generators and paralleling
courses.blurb: How an alternator makes its voltage, the AVR and the governor, synchronising, load sharing and reverse power.

courses.title: Three-phase power systems at sea
courses.blurb: Generators, their speed and excitation, running in parallel, insulated and earthed neutrals, and earth fault detection.

courses.title: Instrumentation and control
courses.blurb: Sensors, transducers and control loops on the plant.

courses.title: HV Subsea Cable Testing
courses.blurb: Your subsea cable testing course taught back to you: make the cable safe, then DLRO, IR and PI, sheath, VLF, TDR and LIRA on one 66 kV wind farm cable, until the fault is found.

courses.title: Fault-finding: from symptom to cause
courses.blurb: Real faults on real equipment, found the way a job reaches you: a starter that won't run, a motor that trips, an earth on a ship's board. From the report to the proven fix.

courses.title: Maintenance and condition monitoring
courses.blurb: Insulation resistance trends and the other checks that catch a fault before it happens.

folders.title: Supply systems
folders.blurb: How a supply stays safe and alive: insulated systems and their earth faults, and the batteries behind them.

courses.title: Insulated systems and earth faults
courses.blurb: Why the first earth fault on an unearthed supply trips nothing, what an insulation monitor reads, and how to find the fault.

courses.title: Batteries
courses.blurb: How a lead-acid cell works, capacity and discharge rate, charging stages, specific gravity, gassing and hydrogen, and cell faults.

folders.title: Installation design (BS 7671)
folders.blurb: Designing and verifying installations ashore to BS 7671, built to your Level 4 course.

courses.title: Design and verification, a Level 4 refresher
courses.blurb: Your Level 4 course taught back to you: recall first, the why where you need it, then practice in the City & Guilds shapes on your own showroom assignment.
